name: Amissa Angelus Project
source:
Join a small band of misfits in a post-apocalyptic world as they take contracts, trying to survive as an organized militia. One day, the Bravado Angels take an unusual contract that is tied to a mysterious cult in South Africa. What he and his soldiers discover there will change life as we know it forever.

This is a game that features characters from Monster Girl Quest in an alternate timeline of Earth where a madman named Dr. Randall Zwinge uses a gating device stolen from Dr. Oblivion to bring beings from different timelines here to enslave them as his soldiers.

In the setting, it is 2020; 11 years ago, in 2009, Dr. Oblivion was kidnapped, and a nuclear holocaust happened, effectively crippling world governments, forcing them to rely on private organizations for police work and security. The Bravado Angels, a private military group made up of the remainder of the US Army, is tasked with a contract by the Union of Nations to rescue Dr. Oblivion and the other high-profile scientists and engineers Dr. Randall has taken hostage.

[From [url=https://amissaangelus.itch.io/amissa-angelus-project]itch.io[/url]]
